scope: All F01–F60 format features, all 2,407 reconciled upstream API records, and all 17 additive bounded-view members in the existing public API map. Proposed command design only; no implemented support or executed product tests.

referenceTestBaseline.status: Prior reference execution only; all adaptation remains unimplemented. No source-case equivalence is inferred from class names.

security.dispatch: Closed static discriminated operation union. No eval, method-name dispatch, arbitrary property traversal, raw host objects or extensible plugin operation names. Research expansion must never become runtime reflection.
security.handles: Batch receiver is a typed owner/fingerprint handle or an earlier resultHandle. Exact type/owner/invalidation checks required; forward references, cycles and cross-owner assignments fail. The closed operation ID selects a fixed domain handler, never a reflected model member.
security.io: Explicit bounded bytes/VFS capabilities only; no host/native/font/time/identity discovery, network or active document execution.
security.publication: Read-side effects follow public-api-map effects_by_access. Noncreating inspect never invokes creating getters. Prevalidate batch, admit all external inputs, apply operations to isolated graph, validate and atomically publish once; pure value/read batches need no output.
security.researchBoundary: Source IDs and reference identities in this research file must not be copied to product source, comments, tests, fixtures or output.

limit.cliEncoding: Repeat --limit NAME=VALUE only for distinct names; lower host ceilings only.

sharedRules.selection: One-based CLI positions; opaque tokens versus simple selectors are exclusive; ambiguous names fail; all is scope-local; no-match mutations fail unless allowEmpty. Default scope slides.
sharedRules.textCardinality: Exactly one first/all/occurrence; literal Unicode-safe replacement.
sharedRules.publication: Exactly output or inPlace for mutation except dryRun; stdout input cannot be inPlace; aliases of input require inPlace; force only explicit destination; binary stdout excludes json except dryRun.
sharedRules.multifile: outputDir plus transaction capability or allowPartialOutput; exact manifest on partial failure.
sharedRules.stdin: One consumer per invocation; -- ends options; repeated scalars and unknown/inapplicable options fail.
sharedRules.limits: Combined work budget, only lower trusted ceilings; observe explicit cancellation.
sharedRules.json: OfficeResultV1; camelCase operation options; dotted command operation IDs; no default text leakage.
sharedRules.units: Integer EMU; nearest once, halfway away from zero; finite/safe checks; explicit CLI suffixes.
sharedRules.discovery: help/schema enumerate this closed union by logical command path even for typed-batch-only operations; capabilities classifies actual implementation, never this proposed status.

diff.1: different; ok true and data.equal false

J01.model_names: Retain neutral source snake_case; no blanket camelCase alias layer.
J01.parameter_order: Source positional order; defaults remain optional positional arguments. Only keyword-only fields become a trailing typed options object with source field names.

reserved_parameter.reason: default is reserved in a TS positional parameter. Object option key default remains legal.

J01.construction: Presentation is an async callable factory. Unit/RGB/chart-data value constructors use new. Returned graph interfaces have no public raw-XML constructor.
J01.operation_options: camelCase; CLI kebab-case; unknown fields rejected.

J02.properties: Direct synchronous getters and assignments. Lazy allocation is not inherently XML mutation; creating getters are explicit mutating operations.
J02.ownership: Owner-bound live handles; cross-owner assignment fails without explicit import. Replacement invalidates old handles deterministically.
J02.arrays: Readonly snapshots unless a row says live membership. Array elements that are handles remain live.
J02.bytes: Fresh Uint8Array copy on return; inputs snapshotted at admission. Caller mutation cannot bypass validation.
J02.dates: Return Date copies so caller mutation cannot change document state.

J03.indexing: SDK numeric sequence lookup is zero-based and checked. CLI ordinals are one-based. Keyed placeholders use idx, never position.
J03.negative: Numeric property lookup rejects negative sequence positions; explicit at accepts negatives only in each collection profile. Negative placeholder keys remain keys.
J03.slice: Only collections marked slice_supported and RGB expose slice(start?, end?, step?). Omitted bounds depend on step direction; end exclusive; negatives normalized against length; clamp bounds; integer nonzero step; step=0 throws ValueError. Return readonly membership snapshot. No slices on other collections.
J03.iteration: Symbol.iterator returns an IterableIterator in source order; includes uses source value/element equality; reversed reverses traversal; count/index retain their source semantics and index miss throws ValueError.
J03.comparison: equals for explicit value/underlying-element comparison; JS reference equality is not overridden.
J03.strings: Category uses label/toString, RGB toString emits six uppercase hex digits; no copied Python scalar method library.

J04.enums: Immutable branded enum values with complete symbols, aliases, numeric/string values, name and XML metadata. Aliases reference the same enum definition. Equal-value named symbols remain addressable.
J04.conversion: from_xml and to_xml validate exact enum/XML members and reject return-only sentinels lacking XML values; validate does not permit arbitrary untyped numbers.
J04.immutability: Source mutable xml_value becomes immutable target metadata.
J04.typo: PERCENT_40 = 6, XML pct40; no ERCENT_40 public alias.
J04.media: OTHER and SOUND both retain numeric value 1; this collision is not independent evidence of audio classification.
J04.ole: PROG_ID dimensions and progId retained; icon filename denotes an original authored asset identifier, never a host path.

J05.numbers: Finite numbers only. Integer positions, enum backing numbers and EMUs require Number.isSafeInteger; reject coercion, nonfinite and unsafe values.
J05.rounding: Convert once to nearest integer, ties away from zero, before and after safe-range validation. Deliberate difference from source truncation and freeform ties-to-even.
J05.centipoints: Floor EMU / 127, including negatives; no bitwise coercion.
J05.rgb: Integer channels 0..255; from_string accepts exactly six ASCII hex digits and rejects trailing characters.
J05.null: Only types containing null admit null. undefined selects an optional default; never conflate null, false, 0 or empty string.
J05.core_dates: Valid UTC Date or absent null on read; setter requires valid Date. Serialize whole UTC seconds, discard milliseconds, never guess timezone.
J05.chart_dates: Use UTC calendar date; ignore time-of-day for spreadsheet category serials. Epoch 1899-12-31 with +1 after day 59 for 1900 leap bug, or 1904-01-01 without that adjustment. numeric_str_val emits one decimal place for date serials.
J05.core_strings: 255 Unicode code points maximum; absent strings read as empty string. Revision is explicit; save never increments it.

J06.input: Uint8Array | ByteSource | VfsPath; no Node streams or ambient path lookup. All input variants return the same Promise type.
J06.publication: Admission/validation before visible mutation; bounded serialization and atomic adapter publication. No hidden external fetch, decoding process or embedded activation.

image_characterization.dpi: Missing/invalid pair falls back to 72 per axis. Normalize finite numeric DPI to nearest ties-to-even integer as source characterization does, then use 72 when outside 1..2048. Geometry conversion independently uses shared ties-away rounding.
image_characterization.authority: Bounded format characterization or an explicit admitted capability; never a native decoder or implicit network. Other format-spec preserve/edit requirements remain additive.
image_characterization.sizing: No dimensions: pixel/DPI native size. One dimension: preserve aspect ratio. Both dimensions: explicit independent size. Placeholder insertion: cover crop. Finite visible-extent rules govern edits; existing negative/greater-than-one crop metadata stays readable.

J07.fonts: font_file is FontMetricsHandle, not a host font filename. Missing matching metrics fails unsupported-edit. Default requested family Calibri/max_size 18 does not grant font discovery.
J07.time: Only explicit context timestamp; omitted creation time remains absent. No wall-clock or author discovery.
J07.assets: Original default presentation, notes parts, poster and OLE icon bytes; never source templates or downloaded decks.
J07.links: Inert metadata only, including executable-looking action targets. No network, process, macro or OLE activation.

J08.transitive: Declared raises are not exhaustive. Shared owner, validation, resource, cancellation, admission, publication and format errors remain observable.

J09.xml: Bounded owned XML/package/line/path views defined in supporting_types and additional view rows; no lxml, arbitrary XPath, eval, callbacks, ambient authority or unrestricted package traversal.
J09.validation: Namespace/MCE-aware safe mutations and relationship consistency; DTD/external entities, traversal/unsafe URIs and host resolution rejected. Never return a raw host or loader object.

J10.text: Whole-object text setters/clear preserve source destructive scope; formatting-preserving text replace is separate.
J10.read_cli: inspect/list/get commands use noncreating queries. Creating model getters are explicitly mutating typed batch operations.
J10.commands: Plural images, tables, properties. Common literal replacement is text replace. Every advanced operation has a closed typed batch record; no dynamic method evaluator.

Read/edit Strict and Transitional without silent conversion; create macro-free presentation/template/show with correct content type
Namespace-aware preservation of unknown attributes/subtrees, order and whitespace; correct AlternateContent branch selection and retained fallbacks
Deck, slide, part, relationship, feature and unsupported-feature inventory; raw XML and stable JSON
Original minimal valid deck, explicit size, authored themes/layouts and structured slide input; populate supplied template
Add, duplicate, remove, reorder, hide/show and rename; preserve IDs on unaffected slides and maintain references
Copy selected slides with dependency closure, notes and resources; deterministic collision remapping and explicit source-theme policy
Inspect/edit names, order and membership; handle deleted slides and extension IDs consistently
Size/orientation, slideshow options, view/grid settings and slide-number start; preserve unsupported settings
Inspect/create/edit supported master content; explicit shared scope and affected-slide reporting
Inspect/create/apply layouts; resolve placeholders by type/index and preserve local overrides; reject ambiguous mapping
Colors, fonts, styles, theme overrides, color maps and effective-value provenance; no destructive flattening
Solid, gradient and picture backgrounds, explicit slide/layout/master scope; preserve unsupported effects
Slide and notes text, paragraphs/runs/breaks/fields, explicit scope and deterministic structural order; no claim of visual reading order
Unicode-safe cross-run literal find/replace; preserve unaffected formatting and hyperlinks; explicit first/all match behavior
Typeface, size, language, bold/italic, underline/strike, baseline, capitalization, spacing, color and run highlighting
Alignment, spacing, margins, indent levels, bullets/numbering, tabs and text direction
Insets, vertical alignment, columns, wrap, autofit settings and rotation; bounded best-fit sizing with explicit supplied metrics, no ambient font discovery
Unicode, combining marks, emoji, RTL, CJK, vertical text and font fallback metadata; preserve complex-script attributes
Slide number/date/footer/header fields and cached text with explicit update policy; no implicit date or PowerPoint evaluation
Create/edit text boxes and documented preset geometry; names, IDs, fill/line/effects, locks and alt text
Inspect/preserve arbitrary path geometry; create/edit a documented bounded path subset; reject unsupported formulas
Position, size, rotation, flips, nested group transforms; group/ungroup only when world geometry can be preserved
Order, align, distribute and duplicate objects with deterministic units; keep connector/timing references coherent
Create/edit endpoints, connection sites and line style; deleting targets requires explicit detach/remove policy
Supported fill/line/alpha/shadow operations; preserve advanced effects, 3D scene and material properties
Read/create/edit grid, text, styles, borders, fills, row/column sizes; preserve theme-dependent formatting
Horizontal/vertical merges and split cells, insertion/deletion through spans with explicit conflict rules
List occurrences versus unique media, part hashes, media types, geometry, crop, alt text, source links and inheritance

Insert all image formats required by the documented public API with bounded type/dimension/DPI admission and sizing/fit; cover PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF and explicitly reconcile other documented types; no implicit host lookup
Replace one occurrence or an explicitly shared resource; clone/rebind when other occurrences must remain unchanged
Crop, contain/cover/stretch, rotation/flips, opacity and picture borders; deterministic EMU arithmetic
Preserve EMF/WMF/TIFF/WDP and animated bytes; SVG insertion requires supplied raster fallback and validated relationship/MCE structure; no decoder/transcoder promise
Extract original bytes by occurrence/hash to bounded safe output names; deduplicate only explicitly; no active SVG execution
Types, series, categories, caches, axes, labels, data links and embedded workbooks; distinguish cached values from authoritative data
Create/edit category area/bar/column/line/pie/doughnut/radar and XY/bubble families with the tested variants, data, axes and styling; exact variant register required
Create/synchronize simple embedded chart-data sheets and chart caches/formula ranges; preserve complex workbooks/external data and reject edits requiring unsupported formula calculation
Preserve extended/chartEx, combination, 3D, trendline, error bars and unsupported chart substructures; no silent downgrade
Inventory/preserve diagram data, layouts, styles, colors and fallback drawing graph; full semantic layout editing is outside scope
Inspect/extract and preserve OMML; allow validated authored OMML insertion; no equation typesetter
Inventory/extract/insert/replace validated local media with poster and relationship consistency; preserve trim/loop/volume metadata; no playback/transcoding
Inspect/preserve captions, tracks and modern media extensions; limited edits only after schema mapping and evidence
Inspect/edit documented cut/fade/push/wipe settings and advance timing; preserve unsupported transitions such as Morph extensions
Read timing graph, triggers, object targets, sequences and effects without executing them
Author/edit a documented entrance/emphasis/exit subset and simple triggers; preserve complex timelines/motion paths; reject unsafe retargeting
Read/edit ordinary URLs and intra-deck navigation; preserve unsupported actions, report active actions, never execute them
Read/create/edit speaker text, notes shapes/master and slide association without conflating slide placeholders with speaker text
Inspect/preserve handout masters, print/view settings and notes page size; supported master text edits require explicit scope
Read/create/edit legacy comments with author IDs/positions/timestamps; inventory/preserve modern threads/mentions/reactions until separately supported
Read/edit core/custom properties and supported tags; retain custom XML and unsupported property types
Inspect/edit alt text and supported decorative flags, duplicate titles and object order; report structural checks without claiming accessibility certification

Inventory/extract/preserve opaque objects; create OLE embeddings from explicit bytes plus icon/program metadata as required by the public API; controls/web extensions/3D remain preserve-only; never activate or recurse automatically
Inventory/preserve font declarations/embedded font parts; no installation, redistribution assurance or font rendering
Detect macros, encryption, protection, signatures and labels; reject unsupported mutations; explicit signature removal only with graph cleanup
Explicit removal policy for selected notes/comments/metadata/links/embedded objects; report exactly what remains; no blanket clean-file claim
Typed JSON text/table/image bindings and repeated slides; fail unknown/missing bindings before mutation; no executable expressions
Prevalidated atomic ordered operations, dry-run effect list, stale-state protection and bounded cumulative resource accounting
Structural/text/media/relationship changes with deterministic ordering; distinguish effective formatting and raw markup differences; no visual-diff claim
Bounded validate/extract/pack, explicit XML-part replacement and content-type/graph validation; no arbitrary filesystem extraction

contract.names.oracle: Shared plural resources and text replace; reject image/table/metadata/top-level replace spellings; -- and aliases work.

contract.selection.oracle: One-based simple selectors versus fingerprinted tokens, ambiguity candidate locations, scope-local all, empty read/mutation and stale-token failure before mutation.

contract.streams.oracle: One stdin consumer; binary stdout purity; supplied VFS only; shell spaces/Unicode and -- filename handling.

contract.publication.oracle: output/inPlace exclusion, force/input alias checks, dryRun validation without publication, cancellation and existing destination atomicity.

contract.multifile.oracle: Transaction or explicit allowPartialOutput with exact manifest; no deletion of existing outputs.

contract.json-errors.oracle: Version 1 fields, deterministic order, bounded errors, detailed SDK categories and ordinary versus diff statuses; difference is successful data.

contract.limits.oracle: Reject cumulative read/decompression/XML/graph/media/output ceilings; no per-input or per-operation budget reset.

contract.capabilities.oracle: Per-feature edit/read/preserve/reject and exact subset; unknown content visible; all operation/help schemas discoverable; proposed never equals implemented.

contract.retention.oracle: Unknown XML/MCE and opaque binary graphs remain lossless after unrelated edit; no renderer/native/network activation.

contract.shared-model.oracle: CLI and SDK use the same domain engine, owner identity, error classes and deterministic effect semantics.

contract.value-absence.oracle: Null/false/zero/empty/undefined remain distinct; numbers and enums reject coercion, nonfinite and unsafe values.

contract.security.oracle: Reject eval, dynamic method/property paths, prototype keys, raw host objects and unlisted operation IDs. External relationships never fetch or execute.

owner-validation.when: A live receiver or argument was invalidated by replacement/removal.
A live argument belongs to another owner and no explicit import was requested.
Host resource ceilings would be exceeded.
Explicit cancellation is observed before publication.

schemaDialect: JSON Schema 2020-12 fragments rooted in this document; $ref resolves locally. x-modelType adds mandatory owner/interface validation; semantic constraints/defaults and sharedRules are normative design requirements. This register is research, not a runtime schema bundle.
resultContract: OfficeResultV1 envelope; each model operation resultSchema describes data. Direct format operations use the specified domain report/manifest/handle and shared envelope; full serialized report schemas remain implementation artifacts. No arbitrary SDK values or runtime reflection.

testProfiles.command-schema: For the named operation, invoke public CLI and operation SDK with equivalent inputs; check arguments/result schemas, unknown/inapplicable-field rejection, declared effects, errors and publication rules. Pair with each linked feature/API semantic case.
testProfiles.artifact-status: All case IDs are proposed acceptance obligations. Null implementationTest means no test exists or ran in this documentation task.
